user.title: Connect to sipgate.io
user.description: Create a sipgate Personal Access Token with `account:read`. Add `rtcm:write` for Hang up/recording, `history:read` for call history, `sessions:calls:write` for click-to-call, and `sessions:sms:write` for SMS.

data_description.token_id: The token ID shown by sipgate when the Personal Access Token is created.
data_description.public_url: The externally reachable base URL for Home Assistant.

webhook.title: Configure the sipgate webhook
webhook.description:
In the sipgate web console, set the Incoming calls webhook URL to:

`{webhook_url}`

The same URL handles newCall, answer, and hangup events. Keep this URL private because the random webhook ID acts as its authentication secret.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to sipgate.io
reauth_confirm.description: The stored sipgate credentials are no longer accepted. Enter a valid Personal Access Token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure sipgate.io
reconfigure.description: Update the sipgate credentials or public Home Assistant URL. If you change the public URL, update the Incoming calls webhook URL in sipgate as well; the webhook ID itself does not change.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to sipgate. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: sipgate rejected these Personal Access Token credentials.
error.invalid_token_id: Enter only the Personal Access Token ID, for example token-ABC123-0. Do not paste ID:secret or a Basic authorization value.
error.invalid_token: Enter the Personal Access Token secret.
error.missing_account_scope: The token is valid but is missing the required `account:read` permission.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS Home Assistant base URL without a query string or fragment.
error.unknown: sipgate returned an unexpected response while validating the token.

abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its temporary state. Start setup again.

init.title: sipgate.io options
init.description: Caller names are optional. Enter one contact per line as `number=Name`. Recent call history always refreshes on startup and when a call ends; set the periodic history interval to 0 to disable polling.

data.include_outgoing: Fire call-started events for outgoing calls

data_description.history_refresh_minutes: 0 disables periodic polling. Use 1–1440 minutes for a fallback refresh interval.

error.invalid_contacts: Contacts must contain one `number=Name` mapping per line.

hang_up.name: Hang up call
hang_up.description: Terminate a running sipgate call using its call ID.

call_id.name: Call ID
call_id.description: The callId received in a sipgate webhook event.

start_recording.name: Start recording
start_recording.description: Start recording an active sipgate call.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.description: Ask sipgate to announce recording to call participants.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stop recording an active sipgate call.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.description: Ask sipgate to announce the recording state change.

click_to_call.name: Click to call
click_to_call.description: Initiate a sipgate click-to-call session. Your source endpoint rings first; after pickup sipgate calls the destination.

from.name: From
from.description: Source extension or number, for example e14 or +442071234567.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional device extension. Required when From is a group/number rather than an extension.

caller_id.name: Caller ID
caller_id.description: Optional caller ID presented to the destination.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS through a sipgate Web SMS extension.

sms_id.name: SMS ID
sms_id.description: The sipgate Web SMS extension ID, for example s0.
